$comment: Completion bar for #29: YouTube auto-captions use rolling cues (each cue repeats the previous line plus the new one, with ~10ms transition cues), and the parser never deduplicated, so transcript notes contained every line 2-3x, degrading retrieval ranking and citation quality. Fix: parseCaptions now runs dedupeRollingCues — drops near-zero-duration (<=50ms) cues, strips prefix repeats of the previous cue, and strips whole-line (>=2 word) suffix overlaps — so each line lands once. Criterion 1 fails before the change (dedupeRollingCues did not exist); 2 runs the media smoke test, which now includes a YouTube-style rolling-cue fixture; 3-4 guard typecheck and build.
